description: This file defines a CMake function `map_issubsetof` that checks whether one map (subset) is a subset of another map (superset). It iterates over keys in the subset map, compares map values, and determines subset inclusion, returning true or false accordingly.

methods.name: map_issubsetof
methods.description: A function that determines if one map is a subset of another by comparing keys and values, handling nested maps and lists.
